item.title: Ask About Our Featured Listings — Wed Sep 2 — LiveMusicAsheville.com
item.description:
Established in February 2019, LiveMusicAsheville.com now reaches thousands of people every week actively searching for live music in the Asheville area. Roughly 60% of our traffic comes from Google Search as we dominate the top of the results for queries such as “Asheville live music” & “live music Asheville”. Meanwhile our direct traffic is experiencing explosive growth, proving more locals are now using us as their go-to music calendar. Our free listings include just the basics of Who’s Playin’ Where & When. Our Featured Listings really stand out among the dozens of events on the calendar every day. While we update every Wednesday for the following Friday thru Thursday, these Featured Listings are published much sooner and include your picture or poster, a description of the event and the venue, website/ticket links and a Google map. We also share these events on our social media stories to help further promote your show.
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: COMING Saturday SEPT. 19th | Pisgah Brewing Presents: Son Volt — Wed Sep 2 — Pisgah Brewing Company Black Mountain
item.description:
Saturday, September 19, 2026 7:30 PM | Doors Open: 6:00 PM | Outdoor Stage | $36.15 adv. Event Details and Tickets
After spearheading the alt-country movement with Uncle Tupelo, Jay Farrar pursued his vision with Son Volt, who recorded three landmark albums in the ’90s before the groundbreaking artist put the band on extended hiatus and cut three solo LPs. Missing the free exchange of ideas and the surprises that inevitably occur when a group of simpatico musicians lock together, Farrar assembled a new lineup of Son Volt in 2004 and has since released nine albums. The latest album, Sound Signal Serenades, was released as a special 2026 Record Store Day limited edition LP. Jay Farrar’s work often seeks out the ghosts of America’s discordant or forgotten past, converses at length with them, and writes songs that stake a claim to a better future. item.title: Jack’s Old-Time Jam — Wed Sep 2, 5:00 PM — Jack Of The Wood
item.description:
Grab some dinner and a pint while enjoying our long-running Old-Time Jam! Featuring many talented musicians from the local WNC area, our traditional Appalachian mountain music jam runs from 5-9pm every Wednesday night at Jack of the Wood! Jack Of The Wood is still a downtown hot spot for food, brews and drink since 1997 and founders Joan and Joe Eckert who still own it, have maintained the original lively English and Irish vibe. The old-time mountain and Irish music jams continue, including a hot bluegrass jam Thursdays and brunch every Sunday. The venue extends a welcoming feeling to regulars and newcomers to this day. https://jackofthewood.com/
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: Jam > Grass > Jam: The Saylor Brothers — Wed Sep 2, 6:30 PM — French Broad River Brewery
item.description:
The Saylor Brothers are a jamgrass fusion group from Asheville, fronted by brothers Will & Ben Saylor, of Brushfire Stankgrass. This project is a foray further into the realm of bluegrass jam, with more emphasis on improvisation piled on top of a structure of traditional bluegrass and innovative original songwriting. As a trio with Greg Stiglets on bass, the band packs a large sound coming from three acoustic instruments, and often adds a fourth player for further improvisational and bluegrass firepower.
Jam > Grass > Jam is not an open bluegrass jam but is a residency featuring a rotating casts of special guests from Asheville’s bluegrass/jamband scene.
French Broad River Brewery is more than just a place to enjoy a drink—it’s a community hub where great beer, delicious pizza, live music, and good times come together. item.title: The Queen Sessions V1 | Featuring Melissa McKinney — Wed Sep 2, 7:00 PM — Hotel Eve Jazz
item.description: Join us at Hotel Eve for the beginning of a new series: The Queen Sessions. This first performance features Asheville singer-songwriter Melissa McKinney as she honors the timeless artistry of Eva Cassidy. Known for her raw, soulful voice, emotional delivery, and commanding stage presence, Melissa is the frontwoman of the horn-powered blues and soul band MAMA—winner of the 2025 MerleFest Band Competition and second-place finalist at the 2026 International Blues Challenge in Memphis. Her music is rooted in blues, soul, jazz, and the rich storytelling traditions of her Southern Appalachian upbringing. Throughout the evening, Melissa will explore the jazz influences that made Cassidy’s interpretations so unforgettable. Beloved songs will be woven together with selections reflecting Melissa’s own musical spirit. item.title: Camino de Asheville - Section 1. Moderate - 6-ish Miles — Fri Sep 4, 5:30 PM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group Please join me for an evening hike around Beaver Lake in Asheville. I think this section has one of the best views in all of Asheville with a nearly a 180 degree view of the surrounding mountains and Asheville.
**Where:** Botanical Garden Parking Lot. GPS: 35.90021, -79.03247
**Pace:** We'll be walking at a brisk 2.5 to 3.0 mph, leaning more toward 3.0 mph, even uphill. Please be mindful of your fitness level, but don’t worry—we'll take breaks at a few spots to let everyone catch up. While we’ll pause, we can’t wait too long, so come ready for a solid workout!
**No-Shows:** I’ll be keeping an eye on no-shows. If you RSVP and don’t show up without changing your RSVP or letting me know ahead of time, you may end up on the waitlist for future hikes.

item.title: Asheville Crokinole Club — Tue Sep 8, 6:00 PM — Taproom At Highland Brewing Co.
item.description:
Crokinole Tuesdays at Highland Brewing Taproom Join us every Tuesday in the Taproom for an evening of flicks, strategy, and friendly competition! We’re hosting the Asheville Crokinole Club—a community of players who love this classic dexterity board game. Never played? No problem! Crokinole is easy to learn and endlessly fun. Players take turns flicking wooden discs across a circular board, aiming for the high-scoring center zones. The twist? If your opponent has discs on the board, you must hit one—miss, and your piece is out! Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just curious, come grab a pint, meet new friends, and test your skills.
Source: Highland Brewing
